# Load Libraries and Datasets
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(tidycensus)
library(tidyr)
library(gt)
library(sf)
library(stringr)
library(tigris)
access <- read_excel("Analysis Datasets/ne_tr._2024.xlsx")
prscrb <- read_csv("Analysis Datasets/Data2023.csv")
```

# Organize specialties/sub-specialties
```{r}
prscrb <- prscrb %>%
  filter(Gnrc_Name == "Carbidopa/Levodopa") %>%
  mutate(specialty = case_when(
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Nurse Practitioner") ~ 1,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Physician Assistant") ~ 2,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Family Practice") ~ 3,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Family Medicine") ~ 3, 
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Internal Medicine") ~ 4,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Neurology") ~ 5, 
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Psychiatry") ~ 6,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Physical Medicine and Rehab") ~ 7,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "General Practice") ~ 8,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Geriatric Medicine") ~ 9,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Emergency Medicine") ~ 10,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Hospitalist") ~ 11,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Nephrology") ~ 12, 
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Psychiatry & Neurology") ~ 13,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Neuropsychiatry") ~ 13,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Pulmonary Disease") ~ 14,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Rheumatology") ~ 15, 
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Sleep Medicine") ~ 16, 
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Cardiology") ~ 17,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Student") ~ 18,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Oncology") ~ 20,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Hematology") ~ 20,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Infectious Disease") ~ 21,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Surgery") ~ 22,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "surgery") ~ 22,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Otolaryngology") ~ 22,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Ophthalmology") ~ 22,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Urology") ~ 22,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Endocrinology") ~ 23,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Gastroenterology") ~ 24,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Allergy") ~ 25,
    str_detect(Prscrbr_Type, "Dermatology") ~ 26,
    TRUE ~ 19),
    advanced_pr = case_when(
      specialty == "1" ~ 1,
      specialty == "2" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0),
    Provider_Type = case_when(
      specialty %in% c(1,2) ~ "APP",
      specialty %in% c(3, 4, 8) ~ "IM/FP/General",
      specialty == 5 ~ "Neurology",
      specialty %in% c(6,13) ~ "Psych/PsychNeuro", 
      specialty %in% c(7,12,14,15,16,17,8,11,9,23,24,20,25,21) ~ "IM subs/Geriatrics/PM&R",
      specialty == 22 ~ "Surgery",
      specialty %in% c(10,18,19) ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ "Other")) %>% 
  filter(Provider_Type != "Neurology")

prscrb2 <- prscrb %>%
  group_by(Prscrbr_NPI, Prscrbr_Last_Org_Name, Prscrbr_First_Name, Prscrbr_City, Prscrbr_State_Abrvtn, Prscrbr_Type, Gnrc_Name, pdmed, agonist, class, specialty, advanced_pr, Provider_Type) %>%
  summarise(
    beneficiaries = if (all(is.na(Tot_Benes))) NA_real_
                    else sum(Tot_Benes, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(NPI = Prscrbr_NPI)

prscrb2 %>%
  write.csv("GitHub/PD-Prescribers-Mapping/data/Levodopa Providers Cleaned.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Visualize provider types
```{r}
provider_table <- prscrb2 %>%
  group_by(Provider_Type) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    `Prescriber Types` = paste(sort(unique(Prscrbr_Type)), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `N (%)` = paste0(n, " (", round(100 * n / sum(n), 1), "%)")
  ) %>%
  select(Provider_Type, `Prescriber Types`, `N (%)`) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = ""
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Provider_Type = "Provider Type",
    `Prescriber Types` = "Prescriber Types",
    `N (%)` = "N (%)"
  ) %>%
  cols_width(
    Provider_Type ~ px(140),
    `Prescriber Types` ~ px(400),
    `N (%)` ~ px(100)
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 11
  )
provider_table
gtsave(
  provider_table,
  "GitHub/PD-Prescribers-Mapping/figures/Provider Type Table.png"
)
```

# Clean Access Dataset
```{r}
quantile(access$SPAR_neuro, probs=c(0.05,0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75,0.9, 0.95))
spar_10 <- access %>% filter(SPAR_neuro <= 0.21382919) %>%
  rename(GEOID = id)
spar_10 %>% 
  write.csv("GitHub/PD-Prescribers-Mapping/data/10th Percentile Access Tracts.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Overall Census Tracts
```{r}
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
tracts_us <- tracts(cb=TRUE, year = 2024)
tracts_us %>%
  write.csv("GitHub/PD-Prescribers-Mapping/data/2024 Census Tracts.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
